attributes.name: raise_and_hold_arm
attributes.text: An arm is raised to a position and held still before lowering.
attributes.definition: The arm lifts to a target position, the hand stays nearly still there for a moment, and then the arm lowers. No repeated motion during the hold.

attributes.name: fast_forward_arm_swing
attributes.text: The arm is drawn back and then swung quickly forward.
attributes.definition: The hand first moves back behind or above the shoulder, then travels quickly forward or forward-down in one fast stroke.

attributes.name: horizontal_arm_sweep
attributes.text: The arm sweeps sideways in a wide horizontal arc.
attributes.definition: The hand moves across the front of the body roughly at a constant height, from one side to the other, with the arm extended.

attributes.name: two_arm_forward_push
attributes.text: Both arms extend forward together from bent elbows.
attributes.definition: Both elbows start bent with hands near the chest or low in front, then both arms straighten forward at the same time.

attributes.name: upward_arm_extension
attributes.text: The arms extend upward until the hands are above the head.
attributes.definition: The hands rise past the face and the elbows straighten so the hands end above the head.

attributes.name: pull_hand_back_to_body
attributes.text: The hand reaches out and is then pulled back toward the body.
attributes.definition: After extending away from the torso, the hand returns toward the actor's own chest or mouth in a clear withdrawing movement.

attributes.name: downward_press
attributes.text: A hand pushes downward onto the other hand or a low point.
attributes.definition: The hand moves down with a short pressing stroke, often with the shoulders over it, and may rise and press again.

attributes.name: rubbing_strokes
attributes.text: A hand slides back and forth repeatedly against a surface of the body.
attributes.definition: The hand stays in contact with the face, head, neck or other hand while making short repeated sliding strokes.

attributes.name: wrist_rotation
attributes.text: The wrist turns so the hand rotates about the forearm.
attributes.definition: The hand and thumb joints rotate around the forearm axis, once or repeatedly, with the arm otherwise steady.

attributes.name: side_to_side_oscillation
attributes.text: A body part moves left and right repeatedly.
attributes.definition: The hand, forearm, or head moves back and forth sideways several times around a fixed center point.

attributes.name: circular_motion
attributes.definition: The hand path closes on itself in a loop, repeated several times, either around the shoulder or over a small area.

attributes.name: leg_kick_extension
attributes.text: One leg swings and straightens quickly away from the body.
attributes.definition: The knee bends to draw the leg back or up, then straightens quickly so the foot moves forward or sideways away from the hips.

attributes.name: hands_move_apart
attributes.text: The two hands separate from each other.
attributes.definition: Starting close together, the two hands move away from each other sideways, outward, or backward along the head.

attributes.name: hands_move_together
attributes.text: The two hands converge toward each other.
attributes.definition: The hands start apart and move toward each other until they meet or nearly meet in front of the body.

attributes.name: single_quick_flick
attributes.text: A hand makes one short, fast flick.
attributes.definition: The hand moves in one sudden short stroke, mainly at the wrist or forearm, and does not repeat many times.
